course_name_original: Competências Transversais: Montagem e Teste de Instalações Laboratoriais
course_name_en: Transversal Competences: Assembly and Testing of Laboratory Installations

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire skills in the field of experimentation (formulation and testing of hypotheses, experimental planning, data search).
Acquire critical and creative thinking skills in solving engineering problems.
Acquire skills in designing, implementing, testing and operating units in a laboratory environment.

teaching_methods: Practical application in a laboratory context
assessment_rules: The final grade (CF) is calculated as 50% for presence in the workshops (PO) and 50% for a test including the workshops' contents (MT). Eligibility for exams requires attendance at least to 80% of the workshops.
bibliography: Robert H. Perry; Perry.s chemical engineers. handbook . ISBN: 0-07-049841-5
